title: Keshavan Madhava Menon v. State of Bombay

content.caseIdentity: Keshavan Madhava Menon v. State of Bombay, 1951 SCR 228
content.holding: Article 13(1) is prospective; it does not render pre-Constitution laws void ab initio or extinguish pre-Constitution offenses and proceedings.
content.relevance: Foundational authority on prospective nature of Article 13(1).

evidence.note: 7-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Case No. 82 of 1950; 1951 INSC 4; 1951 SCR 228; AIR 1951 SC 128.
